title: AgyImagegenStandards
description: Standard specifications for image generation and sprite asset pipelines

green.prompt_clause: isolated on a solid pure neon green background (#00FF00), high contrast, flat lighting, clean sharp silhouette, no shadows on background, no green elements on the subject
green.avoid_when: subject has green elements (vegetation, slimes, emeralds, jade, green hair)

magenta.prompt_clause: isolated on a solid pure vivid magenta background (#FF00FF), high contrast, flat lighting, clean sharp silhouette, no shadows on background, no magenta/pink elements on the subject
magenta.recommended_when: subject has green elements (trees, grass, slime, green cloth)

canvas_sizes.64: Small sprite, miniature item, bullet icon, retro pixel asset
canvas_sizes.96: Standard inventory item, skill badge, low-res hero sprite
canvas_sizes.128: Detailed equipment icon, spell effect, dialog thumbnail
canvas_sizes.256: Full character battle sprite, boss monster, high-res UI icon
canvas_sizes.512: High-fidelity dialog portrait, card battle graphic
